title: Your voice
hint.download: Let the other person hear you in your own voice when Lingora translates what you say. For now it speaks: {languages}.
hint.record: Read a text aloud (about 15 seconds) and Lingora will learn how your voice sounds. It speaks: {languages}.
hint.canFinish: You can finish now, or keep reading so it sounds better.
hint.ready: Recorded ({secs} s). On the Speak card, choose “Your voice”. It speaks: {languages}.
script: Hi, I'm recording my voice so Lingora can speak like me in calls. I like to start the day with a coffee and calmly go over what I have to do. Shall we meet on Thursday afternoon? If you can't, let me know and we'll find another time that works for both of us.
consent: Only your own voice. The recording stays on this computer. For the best result, record somewhere quiet with the microphone close.
problem.silent: Nothing was heard. Check that the right microphone is chosen and try again.
problem.too_short: The recording was too short: read for at least {secs} seconds.
confirmBody: The recording is deleted from this computer. Speak will use a Lingora voice again until you record another one.
